Compare Association Models

Source: R/association_model_helpers.R
compare_association.Rd

Line up the results of two or more stored models (e.g. crude vs adjusted, or female vs male strata) feature by feature.

Usage

compare_association(
  exposomicset,
  source = c("omics", "exposures", "factors", "go_pcs"),
  models = NULL,
  reference = NULL,
  effect = "main",
  terms = NULL
)

Arguments

exposomicset

A MultiAssayExperiment with results from run_association().

source

Association source: "omics", "exposures", "factors", or "go_pcs".

models

Character vector of stored model names to compare. Default NULL compares every model stored for the source.

reference

Model to use as the reference for the derived columns. Defaults to the first of models.

effect

Which effect to compare: "main" (default) or an interacting coefficient name such as "sexMale".

terms

Optional character vector of features to keep.

Value

A tibble with one row per feature and model: term, model, relation, estimate, std.error, p.value, any of p_adjust, n, n_events, then ref_estimate, ref_se, reference, pct_change, z_diff, and p_diff.

Details

The relation column says how each model relates to the reference, which determines which derived statistics are filled in:

  • "same_sample": same samples, different model (e.g. crude vs adjusted). pct_change is the change-in-estimate, 100 * (estimate - reference estimate) / reference estimate; negative values mean the effect shrank in magnitude.

  • "sibling_strata": different strata from the same strata run. z_diff and p_diff test the difference between the two estimates, (b1 - b2) / sqrt(se1^2 + se2^2), which assumes the strata are independent. Comparisons are pairwise against the reference.

  • "unrelated": no derived statistics.

Examples

mae <- make_example_data(
    n_samples = 10,
    return_mae = TRUE
) |>
    run_association(
        formula = list(
            crude = smoker ~ 1,
            adjusted = smoker ~ age
        ),
        source = "exposures",
        feature_set = c("exposure_pm25", "exposure_no2"),
        family = "binomial"
    )
#> Ensuring all omics datasets are matrices with column names.
#> Creating SummarizedExperiment objects.
#> Creating MultiAssayExperiment object.
#> MultiAssayExperiment created successfully.
#> Running GLMs.

compare_association(
    mae,
    source = "exposures"
)
#> # A tibble: 4 × 15
#>   term         model relation estimate std.error p.value p_adjust     n n_events
#>   <chr>        <fct> <chr>       <dbl>     <dbl>   <dbl>    <dbl> <int>    <dbl>

#> 2 exposure_no2 adju… same_sa…   -0.650     0.738   0.378    0.393    10        5
#> 3 exposure_pm… crude referen…   -0.629     0.717   0.380    0.409    10        5
#> 4 exposure_pm… adju… same_sa…   -0.619     0.724   0.393    0.393    10        5
#> # ℹ 6 more variables: ref_estimate <dbl>, ref_se <dbl>, reference <chr>,
